Antigravity Tools

A local-first, modular developer productivity plugin for Google Antigravity featuring a Prompt Library, AI Strategic Roadmap Planner, Codebase Ideation & Security Auditor, and Agency Agents Integration Hub.

--- ## 📑 Table of Contents - [Why Antigravity Tools?](#-why-antigravity-tools) - [Core Modules & Features](#-core-modules--features) - [1. Prompt Library & Dynamic Clipboard Injection](#1--prompt-library--dynamic-clipboard-injection) - [2. AI Strategic Roadmap & Competitor Planner](#2-️-ai-strategic-roadmap--competitor-planner) - [3. Codebase Ideation, Performance & Security Audits](#3--codebase-ideation-performance--security-audits) - [4. Agency Agents Integration & Multi-Agent Handoff](#4--agency-agents-integration--multi-agent-handoff) - [5. Multi-Project Workspace Switcher](#5--multi-project-workspace-switcher) - [Installation](#-installation) - [Prerequisites](#prerequisites) - [Option A: Install as a Google Antigravity Plugin (Recommended)](#option-a-install-as-a-google-antigravity-plugin-recommended) - [Option B: Connect MCP Server Only (Without Sidecar UI)](#option-b-connect-mcp-server-only-without-sidecar-ui) - [Option C: Standalone Web Dashboard & CLI](#option-c-standalone-web-dashboard--cli) - [Updating the Plugin](#updating-the-plugin) - [Configuration, AI Modes & Local Data Storage](#-configuration-ai-modes--local-data-storage) - [Analysis Modes](#analysis-modes) - [Environment Variables](#environment-variables) - [Local Storage Layout](#local-storage-layout) - [Usage Guide](#-usage-guide) - [Method 1: Antigravity Sidecar Aux Pane](#method-1-antigravity-sidecar-aux-pane) - [Method 2: Autonomous AI Agent Execution (23 MCP Tools)](#method-2-autonomous-ai-agent-execution-23-mcp-tools) - [Method 3: Standalone Local Web Dashboard](#method-3-standalone-local-web-dashboard) - [Method 4: Command-Line Interface (CLI)](#method-4-command-line-interface-cli) - [Architecture & Directory Structure](#-architecture--directory-structure) - [Extending with New Modules](#extending-with-new-modules) - [Development & Testing](#-development--testing) - [Troubleshooting](#-troubleshooting) - [License](#-license) --- ## 🌟 Why Antigravity Tools? Antigravity Tools brings four engineering productivity workflows into a single **local-first** TypeScript/Node.js plugin with zero third-party runtime dependencies: - **Four Surfaces, One Core**: Use the interactive **Antigravity Sidecar Aux Pane**, call any of **23 MCP tools** from your AI agent, run the **Standalone Web Dashboard** (`http://localhost:4321`), or automate via the **CLI**. - **Zero Runtime Dependencies**: Built exclusively on Node.js (`18+`) and TypeScript (`5.7+`) — works across **Windows**, **macOS**, and **Linux** without external package bloat. - **Read-Only Project Scanning & Workspace Isolation**: Per-project discovery, competitor insights, roadmaps, and ideation reports are saved inside `~/.gemini/antigravity-toolkit/workspaces/_/`. Scanning a repository never creates or modifies files inside that repo unless you explicitly click **Export** (`ROADMAP.md` / `IDEATION.md`) or run **Agency Integration**. - **Silent Background Workers**: Codebase scans run inside isolated Node.js `worker_threads` ([`src/modules/ai/scan-worker.ts`](./src/modules/ai/scan-worker.ts)), keeping the sidecar HTTP server responsive without spawning extra visible conversations in your Antigravity sidebar. - **Offline-First with Optional Gemini AI**: Works immediately offline using built-in **Deep Code Comprehension**, or upgrades automatically when a Gemini API key is configured (`GEMINI_API_KEY`) or an AI agent saves reports directly via MCP. - **Sandboxed Sidecar Clipboard Bridge**: Copying prompts inside restricted sidecar iframes routes through `POST /api/clipboard` ([`src/web/server.ts`](./src/web/server.ts)) and native OS utilities (`Set-Clipboard` / `clip.exe` on Windows, `pbcopy` on macOS, `wl-copy` / `xclip` / `xsel` on Linux). --- ## 🧩 Core Modules & Features ```text ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ ANTIGRAVITY TOOLS │ ├──────────────────────┬──────────────────────────┬───────────────────────┬───────────────┤ │ 📚 PROMPT LIBRARY │ 🗺️ STRATEGIC ROADMAP │ 💡 CODEBASE IDEATION │ 🤖 AGENCY HUB │ ├──────────────────────┼──────────────────────────┼───────────────────────┼───────────────┤ │ • {{var}} Templates │ • Codebase Introspection │ • Feature Ideas (ci) │ • 280+ Agents │ │ • {{var:default}} │ • Competitor Benchmarks │ • Perf Audits (perf) │ • /pipeline │ │ • Live Preview Modal │ • 3-Phase MoSCoW Plan │ • Security (sec / CWE)│ • [CALL_AGENT]│ │ • Native OS Paste │ • Status & Delete Ctrl │ • Quality & Tech Debt │ • Registry MD │ │ • JSON Import/Export │ • Export ROADMAP.md │ • 0-100 Health Scores │ • Quick Prompts│ │ • 8 MCP Tools │ • 7 MCP Tools │ • 5 MCP Tools │ • 3 MCP Tools │ └──────────────────────┴──────────────────────────┴───────────────────────┴───────────────┘ ``` ### 1. 📚 Prompt Library & Dynamic Clipboard Injection - **Smart Template Variables**: Write reusable prompts with `{{variable}}` or fallback defaults `{{variable:defaultValue}}`. Variables are auto-detected on save and rendered in an interactive split-pane modal with a live preview and character counter. - **One-Click System Clipboard Paste**: Fill placeholders and inject rendered prompts straight into your OS clipboard (`Ctrl+V` ready in chat or editor), backed by the server-side clipboard bridge inside Antigravity sidecar iframes. - **Curated Starter Seeds**: Ships with 5 pre-seeded engineering prompts (`code-review-senior`, `systematic-debugging`, `tdd-feature-implement`, `clean-refactoring`, `architecture-rfc`). - **Search, Organization & Backup**: Instant search (`Ctrl+K`), category pills, tags, ⭐ favorites toggle, usage counter, and JSON import/export with `merge` or `replace` modes. ### 2. 🗺️ AI Strategic Roadmap & Competitor Planner Inspired by the autonomous planning architecture in [AndyMik90/Aperant](https://github.com/AndyMik90/Aperant): - **Automated Project Discovery (`🔬 Scan`)**: Inspects manifests (`package.json`, `pyproject.toml`, `Cargo.toml`, `go.mod`, etc.), source files, and documentation to detect primary language, frameworks, project type, target personas, existing capabilities, and feature gaps. - **Competitor Intelligence (`🥊 Rivals`)**: Benchmarks direct and indirect market alternatives, extracting pain points with severity/impact ratings (`CP-xx`) and market differentiation gaps (`GAP-xx`). - **3-Phase MoSCoW Roadmap (`⚡ Generate Roadmap`)**: Synthesizes discovery and competitor gaps into a phased **Must / Should / Could / Won't** board: - *Phase 1: Foundation & Core Experience* - *Phase 2: Competitor Differentiation & Workflow Power* - *Phase 3: Scale, Ecosystem & Autonomous Intelligence* - **Interactive Feature Controls**: Update feature status (`idea`, `planned`, `in_progress`, `completed`), filter by MoSCoW priority, review user stories and acceptance criteria, copy ready-to-run AI implementation prompts (**Copy Prompt for Feature**), delete individual features (**🗑️ Delete**), or clear the workspace's roadmap, discovery, and competitor data (**🗑️ Delete** in the toolbar). - **Publication-Ready Export (`📄 Export`)**: Writes a structured `ROADMAP.md` directly to the active project root. ### 3. 💡 Codebase Ideation, Performance & Security Audits A 4-pillar static analysis and opportunity discovery engine: 1. **🚀 Code-Revealed Feature Discoveries (`ci-xxx`)**: Feature ideas grounded in your project's real modules and extension points. 2. **⚡ Performance Optimizations (`perf-xxx`)**: Flags blocking synchronous I/O, caching opportunities, and runtime/bundle bottlenecks. 3. **🛡️ Security Hardening (`sec-xxx`)**: Audits for path traversal (`CWE-22`), hardcoded credentials (`CWE-798`), permissive CORS (`CWE-942`), unsafe eval/DOM patterns, and authorization gaps. 4. **🧹 Code Quality & Tech Debt (`cq-xxx`)**: Identifies oversized files, duplication, typing gaps, and missing test coverage. Additional Ideation capabilities: - **0–100 Health Scores Strip**: Live quantitative scores across **Security**, **Perf**, **Quality**, and **Ideas**, recalculated automatically after audits or item deletions. - **Promote to Roadmap**: Convert any finding (`ci-xxx`, `perf-xxx`, `sec-xxx`, `cq-xxx`) into an active feature card on your MoSCoW roadmap with **➕ Promote to Roadmap**. - **Prompt Copying, Deletion & Export**: Copy an implementation/remediation prompt for any finding (**Copy Prompt**), remove individual findings (**🗑️ Delete**), clear the workspace report (**🗑️ Delete**), or export `IDEATION.md` (**📄 Export IDEATION.md**). ### 4. 🤖 Agency Agents Integration & Multi-Agent Handoff Native TypeScript bridge for the 280+ specialist skills from [Agency Agents](https://github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents-app): - **Auto-Discovery (`🔄 Re-Scan`)**: Scans `~/.gemini/config/skills`, `~/.gemini/antigravity/skills`, `.agents/skills`, and `skills/` to index installed `agency-*` skills and parse their frontmatter metadata. - **1-Click Integration (`⚡ Integrate Agency`)**: Generates: - `docs/agency-registry.md` — master table of detected specialist agents, descriptions, and skill paths. - `.agents/workflows/agency-pipeline.md` — `/agency-pipeline` multi-agent squad router. - `.agents/rules/inter-agent-calling.md` — `[CALL_AGENT]` delegation protocol rule. - `agency-readme.md` — end-to-end guide with ready-to-use scenarios. - Injects 5 curated Agency workflow prompts into your Prompt Library. - **Searchable Specialist Directory**: Search all detected specialists by slug or description, copy agent identifiers (**📋 Copy ID**), copy pre-formatted `[CALL_AGENT]` handoff blocks (**✨ Call Agent**), or launch Quick Prompt shortcuts (**🚀 New Project**, **✨ Add Feature**, **🔬 Research**, **🛡️ Reality Check**). ### 5. 📁 Multi-Project Workspace Switcher - Displays the active project name and path in the persistent **📁 Project** header bar. - **Sync**: Queries Antigravity conversation metadata via `/preload.js` and `/api/workspace` to snap to the active conversation's repository. - **Change**: Point Antigravity Tools to any folder path on disk; Roadmap, Ideation, and Agency views refresh immediately using isolated workspace storage. --- ## 🛠️ Installation ### Prerequisites - **Node.js**: `v18.0.0` or higher (`node -v`) - **npm**: `v9.0.0` or higher (`npm -v`) - **Git**: for cloning the repository - **Google Antigravity IDE**: required for Sidecar Aux Pane and Plugin mode ([Antigravity Plugins Docs](https://antigravity.google/docs/plugins/)) - **Linux only (for clipboard copy)**: at least one clipboard CLI installed — `wl-copy` (Wayland), `xclip`, or `xsel` --- ### Option A: Install as a Google Antigravity Plugin (Recommended) #### 1. Clone and Build ```bash git clone https://github.com/spyshow/antigravity-tools.git cd antigravity-tools npm install npm run build ``` *(Optional)* Verify everything compiles and passes all 30 tests: ```bash npm test ``` #### 2. Copy Plugin Files to Antigravity's Global Plugins Directory **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell $target = "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-tools" New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $target -Force | Out-Null Copy-Item -Path "dist", "src", "skills", "rules", "sidecars", "assets", "bin", "plugin.json", "mcp_config.json", "package.json", "README.md" -Destination $target -Recurse -Force ``` **macOS / Linux (Bash):** ```bash TARGET="$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-tools" mkdir -p "$TARGET" cp -R dist src skills rules sidecars assets bin plugin.json mcp_config.json package.json README.md "$TARGET" ``` > **Note:** Make sure `dist/` is included alongside `sidecars/`, because the sidecar entrypoint (`sidecars/prompt_library/dist/server.js`) imports compiled code from `dist/`. #### 3. Enable the Plugin & Sidecar in Antigravity Config Open `~/.gemini/config/config.json` (on Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\config.json`) and ensure the plugin and sidecar entries are registered: ```json { "plugins": { "antigravity-tools": { "enabled": true } }, "sidecars": { "antigravity-tools/prompt_library": { "projectId": "default", "resolvedPermissions": null, "schemaVersion": 1 } } } ``` #### 4. Restart Antigravity Restart Google Antigravity (or start a new session), click the **Plugins** icon in the right-hand Auxiliary Pane, and open **Antigravity Tools**. --- ### Option B: Connect MCP Server Only (Without Sidecar UI) If you only want the 23 MCP tools in Antigravity or another MCP-compatible client, clone and build the repo first (`npm install && npm run build`), then add an entry to your MCP configuration pointing to `dist/mcp-server.js`: ```json { "mcpServers": { "antigravity-toolkit": { "command": "node", "args": ["/absolute/path/to/antigravity-tools/dist/mcp-server.js"] } } } ``` On Windows, use an escaped path such as `"C:\\path\\to\\antigravity-tools\\dist\\mcp-server.js"`. --- ### Option C: Standalone Web Dashboard & CLI You can run the full 4-tab Web UI and CLI directly from your local clone without Antigravity: ```bash # Start the local web dashboard (opens http://localhost:4321 automatically) npm run ui # Custom port or headless mode node dist/cli.js ui --port 8080 --no-open ``` On Windows, you can also invoke the CLI via `bin\agy-tools.cmd` (or add `./bin` to your `PATH` / run `npm link`). --- ### Updating the Plugin ```bash cd antigravity-tools git pull npm install npm run build ``` Then re-run Step 2 of **Option A** to copy updated `dist`, `src`, `skills`, `rules`, `sidecars`, `assets`, `bin`, and manifest files into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-tools`, and restart Antigravity. --- ## ⚙️ Configuration, AI Modes & Local Data Storage ### Analysis Modes 1. **Deep Code Comprehension (Default — Offline / Zero Config)**: Works out of the box with no API key. Parses manifests, file trees, symbols, routes, and security patterns to produce codebase-specific Roadmaps and Ideation reports. 2. **Gemini API Mode (Optional)**: When `GEMINI_API_KEY` or `GOOGLE_API_KEY` is configured (or saved via `~/.gemini/antigravity-toolkit/ai-settings.json` / `POST /api/ai/settings`), Roadmap and Ideation synthesis uses Gemini (`gemini-2.5-flash` by default) to generate deep code-aware JSON reports. 3. **Agent-Authored MCP Mode**: Your Antigravity AI agent can inspect files directly and persist custom findings via `roadmap_save_generated` and `ideation_save_generated`. ### Environment Variables | Variable | Default | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `GEMINI_API_KEY` / `GOOGLE_API_KEY` | *(unset)* | Enables optional Gemini REST calls for Roadmap and Ideation synthesis. | | `AGY_AI_MODEL` | `gemini-2.5-flash` | Overrides the Gemini model used for AI generation. | | `AGY_AI_SETTINGS_PATH` | `~/.gemini/antigravity-toolkit/ai-settings.json` | Custom JSON file path for stored AI settings. | | `AGY_PROMPTS_PATH` | `~/.gemini/antigravity-toolkit/prompts.json` | Custom JSON storage path for your Prompt Library. | | `ANTIGRAVITY_SIDECAR_WEB_PORT` / `AGY_TOOLKIT_PORT` | `4321` | Preferred port for the Web/Sidecar HTTP server (automatically binds a free port if occupied). | ### Local Storage Layout All plugin state lives under `~/.gemini/antigravity-toolkit/`: ```text ~/.gemini/antigravity-toolkit/ ├── prompts.json # Saved & seed prompt templates ├── ai-settings.json # Optional Gemini API key & model config └── workspaces/ └── _/ ├── discovery.json # Project Discovery analysis ├── competitors.json # Competitor intelligence & pain points ├── roadmap.json # 3-phase MoSCoW roadmap & feature statuses └── ideation.json # 4-pillar ideation & health score report ``` --- ## 🚀 Usage Guide ### Method 1: Antigravity Sidecar Aux Pane Open **Plugins → Antigravity Tools** in the right-hand Auxiliary Pane: 1. **Workspace Bar (`📁 Project`)**: Verify the active repository path, click **Sync** to match your open conversation workspace, or click **Change** to target any project folder. 2. **📚 Prompts Tab**: - Search (`Ctrl+K`) or filter by category/⭐ Favorites/tags. - Click **Paste** on any prompt card — fill `{{variables}}` in the modal (if present) and click **Copy & Paste to Clipboard**. - Use **+ New Prompt**, **Import**, and **Export** above the toolbar to manage your library. 3. **🗺️ Roadmap Tab**: - Click **⚡ Generate Roadmap** to run full discovery, competitor analysis, and MoSCoW synthesis in a silent background worker, or run **🔬 Scan** and **🥊 Rivals** individually. - Expand **Project & Market Intelligence** to inspect detected tech stack, gaps, and competitor pain points. - Filter by MoSCoW priority (`All`, `🔴 Must`, `🟡 Should`, `🟢 Could`, `⚪ Won't`), change feature statuses, click **Copy Prompt for Feature**, delete single features (**🗑️ Delete**), export `ROADMAP.md` (**📄 Export**), or clear the workspace's roadmap data (**🗑️ Delete**). 4. **💡 Ideation Tab**: - Review the live **Security / Perf / Quality / Ideas** score strip. - Click **💡 Run Ideation Audit** to run a fresh 4-pillar codebase audit. - Filter by `🚀 Features`, `⚡ Perf`, `🛡️ Security`, or `🧹 Quality`. - Click **➕ Promote to Roadmap**, **Copy Prompt**, or **🗑️ Delete** on any card, **📄 Export IDEATION.md** to save to disk, or **🗑️ Delete** in the toolbar to clear the report. 5. **🤖 Agency Tab**: - View detected specialist count and integration file checklist (`registry.md`, `pipeline.md`, `rules.md`, `readme.md`). - Click **⚡ Integrate Agency** to bootstrap Agency Agents files into your active workspace, or **🔄 Re-Scan** after installing new skills. - Launch **Quick Prompts** or search the directory to **📋 Copy ID** / **✨ Call Agent**. --- ### Method 2: Autonomous AI Agent Execution (23 MCP Tools) Antigravity Tools registers **23 MCP tools** via `mcp_config.json`: | Module | Tool Name | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Prompts (8)** | `prompt_list` | List prompts with optional filters (`category`, `tag`, `search`, `favoriteOnly`). | | | `prompt_get` | Fetch full template, metadata, and declared variables by ID or exact title. | | | `prompt_search` | Quick keyword search across titles, descriptions, and templates. | | | `prompt_render` | Interpolate `{{variables}}` without touching the clipboard. | | | `prompt_paste` | Render template with variables and copy directly to the OS clipboard. | | | `prompt_save` | Create or update a prompt; auto-detects `{{var}}` and `{{var:default}}`. | | | `prompt_delete` | Delete a prompt from the library by ID. | | | `prompt_categories` | List all categories, tags, and prompt counts. | | **Roadmap (7)** | `roadmap_analyze_project` | Run codebase discovery (stack, personas, existing capabilities, gaps). | | | `roadmap_analyze_competitors` | Benchmark competitors, user complaints, and market gaps. | | | `roadmap_generate` | Run the full roadmap pipeline and save `roadmap.json` for the workspace. | | | `roadmap_get` | Retrieve the saved roadmap, phases, features, and progress. | | | `roadmap_update_feature` | Update feature status (`idea`, `planned`, `in_progress`, `completed`). | | | `roadmap_export_markdown` | Write formatted `ROADMAP.md` to the workspace root. | | | `roadmap_save_generated` | Persist an AI-authored `{ discovery, competitors, roadmap }` payload. | | **Ideation (5)** | `ideation_analyze` | Run the 4-pillar audit (features, performance, security, code quality). | | | `ideation_get` | Retrieve the current ideation report and health scores (generates if missing). | | | `ideation_promote_to_roadmap` | Promote a finding (`ci-xxx`, `perf-xxx`, `sec-xxx`, `cq-xxx`) to the roadmap. | | | `ideation_export_markdown` | Write formatted `IDEATION.md` to the workspace root. | | | `ideation_save_generated` | Normalize and persist an AI-authored ideation report with calculated scores. | | **Agency (3)** | `agency_integrate` | Generate `docs/agency-registry.md`, pipeline workflow, rules, readme, and prompts. | | | `agency_list_agents` | List all installed `agency-*` specialist skills with paths and descriptions. | | | `agency_status` | Inspect Agency integration status, generated files, and agent count. | **Example Prompts to Give Your Antigravity Agent:** - *"Inspect this repository and save a code-aware roadmap via `roadmap_save_generated`."* - *"Audit the codebase for security and performance issues and export `IDEATION.md`."* - *"Promote `sec-001` from ideation into the roadmap and mark `FEAT-01` as `in_progress`."* - *"Find the `code-review-senior` prompt in my library and paste it with `language=TypeScript`."* - *"Integrate my installed Agency Agents into this workspace."* --- ### Method 3: Standalone Local Web Dashboard ```bash # Default port 4321 (auto-opens browser) npm run ui # Custom port without opening a browser automatically node dist/cli.js ui --port 8080 --no-open ``` Then visit `http://localhost:4321` (or your chosen port) in any modern browser. Use the **Change** button in the **📁 Project** bar to inspect any project directory on disk. --- ### Method 4: Command-Line Interface (CLI) ```bash # List all prompts (optionally filter by category) node dist/cli.js list node dist/cli.js list Review # Render a prompt with variables and copy to OS clipboard node dist/cli.js paste code-review-senior --var language=TypeScript --var target_code="src/web/server.ts" # Print full prompt JSON definition node dist/cli.js get systematic-debugging # Start Web Dashboard or stdio MCP Server node dist/cli.js ui --port 4321 node dist/cli.js mcp # Show CLI help node dist/cli.js help ``` --- ## 📂 Architecture & Directory Structure Conforms to the [Antigravity Plugins Specification](https://antigravity.google/schemas/v1/plugin.json): ```text antigravity-tools/ ├── plugin.json # Antigravity plugin manifest ├── mcp_config.json # MCP server stdio definition ├── package.json # Package metadata, bin, and npm scripts ├── tsconfig.json # TypeScript compiler config (ESM + ES2022) ├── assets/ # Plugin logo & icon assets (PNG/SVG) ├── bin/ │ └── agy-tools.cmd # Windows CLI wrapper ├── skills/ # Built-in Antigravity agent skills │ ├── ai-roadmap/SKILL.md │ ├── ideation/SKILL.md │ └── prompt-library/SKILL.md ├── rules/ │ └── prompt-library.md # Agent behavioral rules for prompt reuse ├── sidecars/ │ └── prompt_library/ # Sidecar Aux Pane definition & static assets │ ├── sidecar.json # Sidecar process & entrypoint registration │ ├── ui.html # Aux Pane HTML shell (loads /preload.js) │ ├── index.html # Dashboard HTML mirror │ ├── app.js # Client UI controller │ ├── styles.css # Dark-theme UI styles │ └── dist/server.js # Sidecar launcher importing ../../../dist/ └── src/ ├── types.ts # Shared PluginModule & MCP contracts ├── index.ts # Public package exports ├── cli.ts # CLI entrypoint (ui, mcp, list, paste, get) ├── mcp-server.ts # JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP server over stdio ├── config.ts # Storage paths & port resolution ├── modules/ │ ├── registry.ts # Dynamic PluginModule & HTTP/MCP router │ ├── workspace.ts # URI normalization & isolated storage dirs │ ├── prompts/ # Module 1: Prompt library, seeds, OS clipboard │ ├── roadmap/ # Module 2: Discovery, competitors, MoSCoW planner │ ├── ideation/ # Module 3: 4-pillar scanner, health scores, bridge │ ├── agency/ # Module 4: Agency Agents detector & generator │ └── ai/ # Worker threads runner, Gemini client, context builder ├── web/ │ ├── server.ts # HTTP server, /api/* dispatcher, /preload.js & clipboard bridge │ └── public/ # Canonical web assets (synced to dist/web/public & sidecars/) └── tests/ # Automated node:test suite (30 tests across 7 files) ├── agency.test.ts ├── ideation.test.ts ├── interpolator.test.ts ├── roadmap.test.ts ├── service.test.ts ├── storage.test.ts └── workspace.test.ts ``` ### Extending with New Modules All capabilities implement [`PluginModule`](./src/types.ts) and are wired into [`ModuleRegistry`](./src/modules/registry.ts): 1. Create `src/modules//index.ts` implementing `PluginModule` (`getTools`, `handleToolCall`, and optional `handleHttpRequest`). 2. Register it inside `ModuleRegistry` in [`src/modules/registry.ts`](./src/modules/registry.ts): ```typescript this.register(new YourModule()); ``` 3. Run `npm run build` (and `npm test`). Your MCP tools and `/api/*` endpoints are exposed automatically across MCP, CLI, Web UI, and Sidecar modes. --- ## 🧪 Development & Testing ```bash # Compile TypeScript -> dist/ and copy static assets -> dist/web/public/ npm run build # Watch mode during backend TypeScript development npm run build:watch # Build and run the full node:test suite (30 tests) npm test ``` > **Frontend asset note:** [`src/web/public/`](./src/web/public/app.js) holds the canonical frontend files (`ui.html`, `index.html`, `app.js`, `styles.css`). If you edit frontend files, mirror them to [`sidecars/prompt_library/`](./sidecars/prompt_library/) and run `npm run build` so both standalone and sidecar views stay in sync. --- ## 🔧 Troubleshooting - **Sidecar pane fails to load in Antigravity**: Confirm `npm run build` succeeded and that you copied `dist/` alongside `sidecars/` into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-tools/`. - **"Failed to copy to clipboard" on Linux**: Install a native clipboard binary (`sudo apt install wl-clipboard` on Wayland or `sudo apt install xclip` on X11) so `POST /api/clipboard` can write to the system clipboard. - **Port `4321` is already in use**: The server automatically falls back to an available ephemeral port (`EADDRINUSE` handling), or you can set `AGY_TOOLKIT_PORT=4500` / pass `--port 4500` to `node dist/cli.js ui`. - **Showing the wrong project in the sidecar**: Click **Sync** in the **📁 Project** header bar to re-read your active Antigravity conversation workspace, or click **Change** to enter the folder path manually. --- ## 📄 License Licensed under the [Apache-2.0 License](./package.json).

Antigravity Tools

A local-first, modular developer productivity plugin for Google Antigravity featuring a Prompt Library, AI Strategic Roadmap Planner, Codebase Ideation & Security Auditor, and Agency Agents Integration Hub.

--- ## 📑 Table of Contents - [Why Antigravity Tools?](#-why-antigravity-tools) - [Core Modules & Features](#-core-modules--features) - [1. Prompt Library & Dynamic Clipboard Injection](#1--prompt-library--dynamic-clipboard-injection) - [2. AI Strategic Roadmap & Competitor Planner](#2-️-ai-strategic-roadmap--competitor-planner) - [3. Antigravity Tools brings four engineering productivity workflows into a single **local-first** TypeScript/Node.js plugin with zero third-party runtime dependencies: - **Four Surfaces, One Core**: Use the interactive **Antigravity Sidecar Aux Pane**, call any of **23 MCP tools** from your AI agent, run the **Standalone Web Dashboard** (`http://localhost:4321`), or automate via the **CLI**. - **Zero Runtime Dependencies**: Built exclusively on Node.js (`18+`) and TypeScript (`5.7+`) — works across **Windows**, **macOS**, and **Linux** without external package bloat. - **Read-Only Project Scanning & Workspace Isolation**: Per-project discovery, competitor insights, roadmaps, and ideation reports are saved inside `~/.gemini/antigravity-toolkit/workspaces/_/`. Scanning a repository never creates or modifies files inside that repo unless you explicitly click **Export** (`ROADMAP.md` / `IDEATION.md`) or run **Agency Integration**. - **Silent Background Workers**: Codebase scans run inside isolated Node.js `worker_threads` ([`src/modules/ai/scan-worker.ts`](./src/modules/ai/scan-worker.ts)), keeping the sidecar HTTP server responsive without spawning extra visible conversations in your Antigravity sidebar. - **Offline-First with Optional Gemini AI**: Works immediately offline using built-in **Deep Code Comprehension**, or upgrades automatically when a Gemini API key is configured (`GEMINI_API_KEY`) or an AI agent saves reports directly via MCP. - **Sandboxed Sidecar Clipboard Bridge**: Copying prompts inside restricted sidecar iframes routes through `POST /api/clipboard` ([`src/web/server.ts`](./src/web/server.ts)) and native OS utilities (`Set-Clipboard` / `clip.exe` on Windows, `pbcopy` on macOS, `wl-copy` / `xclip` / `xsel` on Linux). --- ## 🧩 Core Modules & Features ```text ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ ANTIGRAVITY TOOLS │ ├──────────────────────┬──────────────────────────┬───────────────────────┬───────────────┤ │ 📚 PROMPT LIBRARY │ 🗺️ STRATEGIC ROADMAP │ 💡 CODEBASE IDEATION │ 🤖 AGENCY HUB │ ├──────────────────────┼──────────────────────────┼───────────────────────┼───────────────┤ │ • {{var}} Templates │ • Codebase Introspection │ • Feature Ideas (ci) │ • 280+ Agents │ │ • {{var:default}} │ • Competitor Benchmarks │ • Perf Audits (perf) │ • /pipeline │ │ • Live Preview Modal │ • 3-Phase MoSCoW Plan │ • Security (sec / CWE)│ • [CALL_AGENT]│ │ • Native OS Paste │ • Status & Delete Ctrl │ • Quality & Tech Debt │ • Registry MD │ │ • JSON Import/Export │ • Export ROADMAP.md │ • 0-100 Health Scores │ • Quick Prompts│ │ • 8 MCP Tools │ • 7 MCP Tools │ • 5 MCP Tools │ • 3 MCP Tools │ └──────────────────────┴──────────────────────────┴───────────────────────┴───────────────┘ ``` ### 1. 📚 Prompt Library & Dynamic Clipboard Injection - **Automated Project Discovery (`🔬 Scan`)**: Inspects manifests (`package.json`, `pyproject.toml`, `Cargo.toml`, `go.mod`, etc.), source files, and documentation to detect primary language, frameworks, project type, target personas, existing capabilities, and feature gaps. - **Change**: Point Antigravity Tools to any folder path on disk; Roadmap, Ideation, and Agency views refresh immediately using isolated workspace storage. --- ## 🛠️ Installation ### Prerequisites - **Node.js**: `v18.0.0` or higher (`node -v`) - **npm**: `v9.0.0` or higher (`npm -v`) - **Git**: for cloning the repository - **Google Antigravity IDE**: required for Sidecar Aux Pane and Plugin mode ([Antigravity Plugins Docs](https://antigravity.google/docs/plugins/)) - **Linux only (for clipboard copy)**: at least one clipboard CLI installed — `wl-copy` (Wayland), `xclip`, or `xsel` --- ### Option A: Install as a Google Antigravity Plugin (Recommended) #### 1. Clone and Build ```bash git clone https://github.com/spyshow/antigravity-tools.git cd antigravity-tools npm install npm run build ``` *(Optional)* Verify everything compiles and passes all 30 tests: ```bash npm test ``` #### 2. Copy Plugin Files to Antigravity's Global Plugins Directory **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell $target = "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-tools" New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $target -Force | Out-Null Copy-Item -Path "dist", "src", "skills", "rules", "sidecars", "assets", "bin", "plugin.json", "mcp_config.json", "package.json", "README.md" -Destination $target -Recurse -Force ``` **macOS / Linux (Bash):** ```bash TARGET="$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-tools" mkdir -p "$TARGET" cp -R dist src skills rules sidecars assets bin plugin.json mcp_config.json package.json README.md "$TARGET" ``` > **Note:** Make sure `dist/` is included alongside `sidecars/`, because the sidecar entrypoint (`sidecars/prompt_library/dist/server.js`) imports compiled code from `dist/`. #### 3. Enable the Plugin & Sidecar in Antigravity Config Open `~/.gemini/config/config.json` (on Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\config.json`) and ensure the plugin and sidecar entries are registered: ```json { "plugins": { "antigravity-tools": { "enabled": true } }, "sidecars": { "antigravity-tools/prompt_library": { "projectId": "default", "resolvedPermissions": null, "schemaVersion": 1 } } } ``` #### 4. Restart Antigravity Restart Google Antigravity (or start a new session), click the **Plugins** icon in the right-hand Auxiliary Pane, and open **Antigravity Tools**. --- ### Option B: Connect MCP Server Only (Without Sidecar UI) If you only want the 23 MCP tools in Antigravity or another MCP-compatible client, clone and build the repo first (`npm install && npm run build`), then add an entry to your MCP configuration pointing to `dist/mcp-server.js`: ```json { "mcpServers": { "antigravity-toolkit": { "command": "node", "args": ["/absolute/path/to/antigravity-tools/dist/mcp-server.js"] } } } ``` On Windows, use an escaped path such as `"C:\\path\\to\\antigravity-tools\\dist\\mcp-server.js"`. --- ### Option C: Standalone Web Dashboard & CLI You can run the full 4-tab Web UI and CLI directly from your local clone without Antigravity: ```bash # Start the local web dashboard (opens http://localhost:4321 automatically) npm run ui # Custom port or headless mode node dist/cli.js ui --port 8080 --no-open ``` On Windows, you can also invoke the CLI via `bin\agy-tools.cmd` (or add `./bin` to your `PATH` / run `npm link`). --- ### Updating the Plugin ```bash cd antigravity-tools git pull npm install npm run build ``` Then re-run Step 2 of **Option A** to copy updated `dist`, `src`, `skills`, `rules`, `sidecars`, `assets`, `bin`, and manifest files into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-tools`, and restart Antigravity. --- ## ⚙️ Configuration, AI Modes & Local Data Storage ### Analysis Modes 1. **Deep Code Comprehension (Default — Offline / Zero Config)**: Works out of the box with no API key. Parses manifests, file trees, symbols, routes, and security patterns to produce codebase-specific Roadmaps and Ideation reports. 2. **Gemini API Mode (Optional)**: When `GEMINI_API_KEY` or `GOOGLE_API_KEY` is configured (or saved via `~/.gemini/antigravity-toolkit/ai-settings.json` / `POST /api/ai/settings`), Roadmap and Ideation synthesis uses Gemini (`gemini-2.5-flash` by default) to generate deep code-aware JSON reports. 3. **Agent-Authored MCP Mode**: Your Antigravity AI agent can inspect files directly and persist custom findings via `roadmap_save_generated` and `ideation_save_generated`. ### Environment Variables | Variable | Default | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `GEMINI_API_KEY` / `GOOGLE_API_KEY` | *(unset)* | Enables optional Gemini REST calls for Create `src/modules//index.ts` implementing `PluginModule` (`getTools`, `handleToolCall`, and optional `handleHttpRequest`). 2. Register it inside `ModuleRegistry` in [`src/modules/registry.ts`](./src/modules/registry.ts): ```typescript this.register(new YourModule()); ``` 3. Run `npm run build` (and `npm test`). Your MCP tools and `/api/*` endpoints are exposed automatically across MCP, CLI, Web UI, and Sidecar modes. --- ## 🧪 Development & Testing ```bash # Compile TypeScript -> dist/ and copy static assets -> dist/web/public/ npm run build # Watch mode during backend TypeScript development npm run build:watch # Build and run the full node:test suite (30 tests) npm test ``` > **Frontend asset note:** [`src/web/public/`](./src/web/public/app.js) holds the canonical frontend files (`ui.html`, `index.html`, `app.js`, `styles.css`). If you edit frontend files, mirror them to [`sidecars/prompt_library/`](./sidecars/prompt_library/) and run `npm run build` so both standalone and sidecar views stay in sync. --- ## 🔧 Troubleshooting - **Sidecar pane fails to load in Antigravity**: Confirm `npm run build` succeeded and that you copied `dist/` alongside `sidecars/` into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-tools/`. - **"Failed to copy to clipboard" on Linux**: Install a native clipboard binary (`sudo apt install wl-clipboard` on Wayland or `sudo apt install xclip` on X11) so `POST /api/clipboard` can write to the system clipboard. - **Port `4321` is already in use**: The server automatically falls back to an available ephemeral port (`EADDRINUSE` handling), or you can set `AGY_TOOLKIT_PORT=4500` / pass `--port 4500` to `node dist/cli.js ui`. - **Showing the wrong project in the sidecar**: Click **Sync** in the **📁 Project** header bar to re-read your active Antigravity conversation workspace, or click **Change** to enter the folder path manually. --- ## 📄 License Licensed under the [Apache-2.0 License](./package.json).
